snippet.title: Tanveer Evan - Royaa Main (रोया मैं) | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Royaa Main (रोया मैं | رویا میں) — a story of love that stayed, even when the person didn’t.

Some people leave, but their memories never really do. They remain in the quiet nights, familiar places, unfinished conversations, and dreams you wish you could return to.

“Khoya main, khoya main, khoya
Tere pyaar mein khoya
Royaa main, royaa main, royaa
Tere pyaar mein royaa…”

Royaa Main captures the feeling of losing yourself in someone falling so deeply in love that even after they’re gone, a part of you is still waiting for them.

A song for everyone who has ever loved, lost, and still remembered. ❤️‍🩹


Lyrics :
Khoya main, khoya main, khoya
Tere pyaar mein khoya
Royaa main, royaa main, royaa
Tere pyaar mein royaa..

Tu jo mila tha, sapna laga tha
Ab ye sapna bhi jhootha... 
Dil ye mera tanha sa rehta
Tere bina chaand bhi soona..

Yaadein teri yaadon mein basi hai
Aisi fasi jaise Tere hi naam liye...
Yaadein teri aati rahe,
chand muskurati rahe
tere hi khaab liye..

Royaa main, royaa main, royaa
Tere pyaar mein royaa
Khoya main, khoya main, 
khoyaTere pyaar mein khoya.. 2x

Dekha tha  tumko main
Khoya unn aankhon mein aise...
Palkein jhapakte hi
Kho geya khwaabon main .
Jaise khwaab se zyada
Tera milna zaroori hain,
Aise  meri dua o main 
Teri zikr, hain har dafa 

Yaadein teri yaadon mein basi hain
Aisi fasi jaise Tere hi naam liye..
Yaadein teri aati rahe, 
aansu main bahata rahu ,
Tere hi khwaab liye...

Royaa main, royaa main, royaa
Tere pyaar mein royaa
Khoya main, khoya main, khoya
Tere pyaar mein khoya 2x

গ্রাম বাংলার মাটিতে মিশে থাকে কত গল্প, কত রহস্য, কত চেনা-অচেনা নিয়মকানুন। সেই মাটিরই সরল গল্পে জড়িয়ে পড়ে দুই খুদে। সম্পর্কটা ক্ষণিকের, কিন্তু তাদের খুনসুটি, হাসি আর ছোট ছোট মুহূর্তগুলো যেন থেকে যায় মনের গভীরে, চিরকাল।
শুনে নিন 'মায়া সত্য ভ্রম' সিনেমা থেকে তমাল কান্তি হালদারের সুরে, প্রলয় সরকারের লেখায় লগ্নজিতা চক্রবর্তীর গাওয়া গান 'খুকুমনির বে', শুধুমাত্র @SVFMusic.

The soil of rural Bengal holds countless stories, mysteries, and familiar as well as unfamiliar traditions. Woven into one such simple tale is the wedding of two little ones. Their bond may be fleeting, but their playful banter, laughter, and little moments together will remain etched deep in their hearts, forever.
Listen to ‘Khukumonir Be’, from the film ‘Maya Satya Bhram’, sung by Lagnajita Chakraborty, with music by Tamal Kanti Halder and lyrics by Pralay Sarkar, only on @SVFMusic.
